results.name: Bird Dog
instructions: Start in a tabletop position on your hands and knees, with your wrists aligned under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Extend your left leg backward, toes extended back, and right arm forward simultaneously, keeping your extending arm straight, until both are parallel to the floor.
Hold this position briefly, maintaining balance and stability.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement with your left arm and right leg.
tips: Engage your core to maintain stability and prevent your back from sagging.
Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize muscle activation and improve balance.
Focus on keeping your extended arm and leg parallel to the floor to ensure proper form.
results.description: Bird Dog is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Body Saw Plank
instructions: Start in a forearm plank position, with your elbows directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Rock your body back by pushing through your forearms, moving your shoulders behind your elbows level.
Rock your body forward by pulling with your forearms, moving your shoulders in front of your elbows level.
Repeat this controlled forward and backward motion.
tips: Focus on keeping your body in a straight line from head to heels to maintain proper form.
Ensure your movements are slow and deliberate to enhance control and muscle engagement.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you rock forward and inhaling as you rock back.
results.description: Body Saw Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Glutes, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Bodyweight Kneeling Push-Up Row
instructions: Start in a kneeling push-up position with your hands placed slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your body on the floor.
Push up by extending both arms, keeping your knees on the floor. Lift your right hand off the floor, performing a rowing motion by bringing your elbow up towards the ceiling.
Return your right hand to the floor and lower your body to the starting position.
Repeat alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Engage your core to maintain stability and prevent your hips from sagging during the push-up and row.
Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize muscle activation and avoid injury.
Focus on a full range of motion in both the push-up and the rowing movement to ensure effectiveness.
results.description: Bodyweight Kneeling Push-Up Row is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Core.

results.name: Bow Pose
instructions: Lie face down with your legs stretched back and your arms extended in front of you, palms facing down.
Bend your knees and reach back to grasp your ankles with your hands.
Lift your chest and thighs off the floor by pressing your legs into your hands until you feel a comfortable stretch.
Hold the position for the desired duration, then slowly lower your body and release your ankles.
tips: Engage your core to help stabilize your spine.
Avoid forcing the stretch beyond a comfortable range of motion.
Lift your chest by pressing your legs into your hands rather than pulling with your arms.
Breathe slowly and evenly while holding the stretch.
results.description: Bow Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Chest, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Bridge Hip Abduction
instructions: Begin by lying on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor at shoulder width, and arms extended by your sides.
Lift your hips off the floor to form a straight line from your shoulders to your knees, engaging your glutes and core.
While keeping your hips elevated, move your knees outwards in a controlled manner and back.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
Ensure your hips remain elevated and level throughout the exercise to maximize glute activation.
Perform the leg abductions slowly and with control to avoid any jerky movements and enhance muscle engagement.
results.description: Bridge Hip Abduction is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Abductors, Hamstrings.

results.name: Bridge Pose Setu Bandhasana
instructions: Lie down on your back with your knees bent, feet together on the floor, and arms resting at your sides.
Raise your hips and straighten your thighs with your back while your knees are closed.
Maintain this position, raise your arms and then land them overhead with your palms facing upward.
Return to the initial position and repeat.
tips: Keep your feet hip-width apart and ensure your knees stay aligned with your ankles to maintain proper form.
Engage your core and glutes to support your lower back and maintain stability.
Breathe deeply and evenly throughout the pose, relaxing your shoulders and neck.
results.description: Bridge Pose Setu Bandhasana is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Quadriceps.

results.name: Bridge With Alternating Leg Raise
instructions: Begin by lying on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and arms resting by your sides.
Lift your hips off the floor to form a straight line from your shoulders to your knees, engaging your glutes and core.
While keeping your hips elevated, extend your right leg straight keeping it in level with torso, then lower it back to the starting position.

Repeat the movement with your left leg, extending it straight keeping it in level with torso, then lowering it back to the starting position. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and support your lower back.
Ensure your hips remain elevated and level throughout the exercise to maximize glute activation.
Perform the leg raises slowly and with control to avoid any jerky movements and to enhance muscle engagement.
results.description: Bridge With Alternating Leg Raise is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Quadriceps.

results.name: Butterfly Yoga Pose
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs bent and the soles of your feet pressed together, allowing your knees to fall out to the sides.
Hold your feet with both hands and sit up tall, then lean forward slightly towards the floor, creating a gentle arch in your back.
Press your knees gently towards the floor to deepen the stretch in your hips.
Hold the position for the desired duration, breathing deeply and evenly throughout.
tips: Maintain a gentle arch in your back while leaning forward to ensure a proper stretch and avoid straining.
Inhale deeply and exhale slowly throughout the pose to help relax your muscles and enhance the stretch.
Apply gentle pressure to your knees without forcing them down to prevent overstraining your hip joints.
results.description: Butterfly Yoga Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the adductors (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Cat Pose
instructions: Begin on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips. Keep your arms straight and your gaze toward the floor.
Slowly round your back toward the ceiling by tucking your chin toward your chest and drawing your tailbone underneath you.
Hold the stretched position briefly while keeping your shoulders relaxed and your core gently engaged.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your hands directly beneath your shoulders and your knees beneath your hips.
Draw your belly button inward to help deepen the spinal movement.
Round your spine evenly from your neck to your lower back.
Inhale in the starting position and exhale as you round your back.
results.description: Cat Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Core, Upper Back, Shoulders.

results.name: Cat Stretch
instructions: Begin on your hands and knees in a tabletop position, with your wrists aligned under your shoulders and your knees aligned under your hips.
Inhale deeply, then slowly arch your back upwards towards the ceiling, tucking your chin towards your chest and drawing your navel in towards your spine.
Hold the arched position for a few seconds, feeling the stretch along your spine and back muscles.
Exhale and slowly return to the starting tabletop position. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on your breath, inhaling deeply as you arch your back and exhaling as you return to the starting position.
Ensure your wrists and knees remain aligned throughout the exercise to maintain proper form and avoid strain.
Relax your neck and avoid straining it as you tuck your chin towards your chest.
Perform this stretch as part of a cool-down routine or whenever you need to relieve tension in your back.
results.description: Cat Stretch is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Traps, Lats.
